comment: Shared gear score fixture. The API's sims.GearScore(gear_code, spec) and the addon's Gear.score(stats, weights) summed over items must both equal expected_score.

Gear set: Data.lua bis["warrior-arms"][20].alliance, one item per slot. Stat lines: data/builds/1.60.1.70291/items/warrior.json (each item's stats map, the same stat line builds.AddonCode writes into the addon code; items.json at the build root carries no stats). Weights: data/curated/stat-weights.json warrior-arms, the table Data.lua ships as weights["warrior-arms"].
Score = sum over items of sum over stats of value * weight, a stat with no weight counting 0 (stamina and spirit here). Hit and crit are one stat each; this set carries neither.

By hand: back 4706 str 4 = 8; chest 6627 str 10 = 20; feet 10402 agi 6 = 3.6; finger1 20439 str 4 + agi 4 = 8 + 2.4 = 10.4; finger2 12054 str 4 = 8; hands 10401 str 6 = 12; head 250528 str 10 = 20; legs 10400 str 6 + agi 6 = 12 + 3.6 = 15.6; main_hand 23171 str 14 = 28; neck 20444 agi 6 = 3.6; ranged 285279 str 2 = 4; shoulder 3480 str 3 = 6; waist 10403 ap 18 = 18; wrist 2868 str 5 = 10.
Check by stat: strength 68 * 2 = 136; agility 22 * 0.6 = 13.2; attack_power 18 * 1 = 18; total 136 + 13.2 + 18 = 167.2.
